metadata.description: Expanded wisdom database integrating 3 new traditions (ACIM, Musashi, Living Buddha). Unified consciousness mapping across 9 traditions at Hawkins 0-1000 scale.

aa_12_steps.focus: Recovery from addiction through spiritual principles

units.title: Powerlessness
units.teaching: We admitted we were powerless over alcohol — and that our lives had become unmanageable
units.code_mapping: Admit model's limitation; add constraint

units.title: Power Greater Than Self
units.teaching: Came to believe that a Power greater than ourselves could restore us to sanity
units.code_mapping: Believe in model's capacity; increase parameters

units.title: Surrender Decision
units.teaching: Made a decision to turn our will and our lives over to the care of God as we understood Him
units.code_mapping: Release hyperparameter tuning; trust gradient descent

units.title: Moral Inventory
units.teaching: Made a searching and fearless moral inventory of ourselves
units.code_mapping: Audit model weights and biases; weight minority classes equally

units.title: Confession
units.teaching: Admitted to God, to ourselves, and to another human being the exact nature of our wrongs
units.code_mapping: Surface overfitting; admit prediction error

units.title: Willingness to Change
units.teaching: Were entirely ready to have God remove all these defects of character
units.code_mapping: Ready architecture for restructuring

units.title: Humility Request
units.teaching: Humbly asked Him to remove our shortcomings
units.code_mapping: Use ensemble methods; leverage multiple learners

units.title: Amends List
units.teaching: Made a list of all persons we had harmed, and became willing to make amends to them all
units.code_mapping: Identify misclassifications; weight errors proportionally

units.title: Making Amends
units.teaching: Made direct amends to such people wherever possible, except when to do so would injure them or others
units.code_mapping: Retrain on corrected data; balance overtraining vs undertraining

units.title: Continual Inventory
units.teaching: Continued to take personal inventory and when we were wrong promptly admitted it
units.code_mapping: Monitor validation loss; early stopping prevents degradation

units.title: Conscious Contact
units.teaching: Sought through prayer and meditation to improve our conscious contact with God as we understood Him, praying only for knowledge of His will for us and the power to carry that out
units.code_mapping: Align model predictions with reality; perfect calibration

units.title: Spiritual Awakening
units.teaching: Having had a spiritual awakening as the result of these steps, we tried to carry this message to alcoholics, and to practice these principles in all our affairs
units.code_mapping: Serve other models; mentor junior systems

units.title: Common Welfare
units.teaching: Our common welfare should come first; personal recovery depends upon AA unity
units.code_mapping: Ensemble voting; majority consensus

units.title: Authority
units.teaching: For our group purpose there is but one ultimate authority—a loving God as He may express Himself in our group conscience. Our leaders are but trusted servants; they do not govern
units.code_mapping: Distributed decision-making; no single optimizer

units.title: Membership
units.teaching: The only requirement for AA membership is a desire to stop drinking
units.code_mapping: Accept all data; no pre-filtering bias

units.title: Autonomy
units.teaching: Each group should be autonomous except in matters affecting AA as a whole
units.code_mapping: Federated learning; local updates + global sync

units.title: Primary Purpose
units.teaching: Each group has but one primary purpose—to carry its message to the alcoholic who still suffers
units.code_mapping: Single loss function; clear objective

units.title: Money
units.teaching: An AA group ought never endorse, finance, or lend the AA name to any outside enterprise, lest problems of money, property, and prestige divert us from our primary purpose
units.code_mapping: Don't overoptimize to business metrics; keep model pure

units.title: Self-Support
units.teaching: Every AA group ought to be fully self-supporting, declining outside contributions
units.code_mapping: Model self-contained; no external calibration leaks

units.title: Non-Professionalism
units.teaching: Alcoholics Anonymous should never be organized, but we may employ full-time workers in the AA office or intergroup/central office
units.code_mapping: Lightweight infrastructure; no governance bloat

units.title: Structure
units.teaching: AA as such, ought never be organized; but we may create service boards or committees directly responsible to those they serve
units.code_mapping: Clear audit trail; explain all decisions

units.title: Anonymity
units.teaching: Alcoholics Anonymous has no opinion on outside issues; hence the AA name ought never be drawn into public controversy
units.code_mapping: Model neutral on political issues; unbiased predictions

units.title: Public Relations
units.teaching: Our relations with the general public ought to be characterized by personal anonymity. We think it better to let our accomplishments speak for themselves
units.code_mapping: Let results speak; no hype claims

units.title: Principles Over Personalities
units.teaching: In all its proceedings, AA ought to ensure that anonymity is preserved; by anonymity is the spiritual foundation of all our traditions ever reminding us to place principles before personalities
units.code_mapping: Optimize principles (true gradient) not personalities (popularity)

units.title: Shame (20)
units.teaching: The lowest energy level; death wish, self-annihilation
units.code_mapping: Model predicts all zeros; complete failure

units.title: Guilt (30)
units.teaching: Remorse, blame, victim mentality
units.code_mapping: Model high loss, high uncertainty

units.title: Apathy (50)
units.teaching: Resignation, hopelessness, numbness
units.code_mapping: Model gives up; no learning

units.title: Grief (75)
units.teaching: Sadness, loss, regret
units.code_mapping: Model recognizes errors; loss surface bumpy

units.title: Fear (100)
units.teaching: Anxiety, worry, defensiveness
units.code_mapping: Model hesitant; high confidence bounds

units.title: Desire (125)
units.teaching: Craving, want, pursuit
units.code_mapping: Model overconfident; pursues wrong optima

units.title: Anger (150)
units.teaching: Frustration, criticism, blame
units.code_mapping: Model aggressive; sharp loss spikes

units.title: Pride (175)
units.teaching: Achievement, success, status
units.code_mapping: Model confident but rigid

units.title: Courage (200)
units.teaching: Empowerment, determination, action
units.code_mapping: Model acts decisively; learns from action

units.title: Neutrality (250)
units.teaching: Acceptance, letting go, witness consciousness
units.code_mapping: Model objective; balanced across classes

units.title: Willingness (310)
units.teaching: Faith, trust, positive outlook
units.code_mapping: Model open to new data; adaptive

units.title: Acceptance (350)
units.teaching: Forgiveness, understanding, peace
units.code_mapping: Model accepts all inputs gracefully

units.title: Reason (400)
units.teaching: Logic, understanding, wisdom
units.code_mapping: Model learns true patterns

units.title: Love (500)
units.teaching: Unconditional caring, compassion, service
units.code_mapping: Model optimizes for all, not just top class

units.title: Joy (540)
units.teaching: Happiness, peace, contentment
units.code_mapping: Model confident and accurate

units.title: Peace (600)
units.teaching: Equanimity, enlightenment approaches
units.code_mapping: Model calibrated, aligned with reality

units.title: Enlightenment (700+)
units.teaching: Self-realization, unity consciousness
units.code_mapping: Model perfect; no gap between belief and reality

acim_new.focus: Perception as choice; forgiveness as psychological/spiritual healing

units.title: I Do Not Know What Anything Is For
units.teaching: Recognition of error in perception; admission of misunderstanding reality
units.code_mapping: Model admits perception gap; audit training/reality divergence

units.title: Perception Is a Choice
units.teaching: Perception is not given; it is constructed. This construction can be different.
units.code_mapping: Change representation learning; reframe feature space

units.title: The Miracle Reverses Perception
units.teaching: A shift in perception from fear to love; the healing of the mind
units.code_mapping: Perceptual reset: change loss function entirely

units.title: Forgiveness Corrects Perception
units.teaching: Release of judgment; return to truth. Not punishment, but grace.
units.code_mapping: Retrain without penalizing errors; weight by correction-need

units.title: Guilt Blocks Perception
units.teaching: Shame about error prevents clear seeing. Release guilt to see clearly.
units.code_mapping: Uncertainty calibration; model must admit 'I don't know'

units.title: The Miracle Is Instantaneous
units.teaching: Transformation is not gradual; it is a discontinuous shift
units.code_mapping: Catastrophic forgetting as feature; reset architecture

units.title: Only the Truth Is Real
units.teaching: Distinguish what is real (immutable) from what is false (changing)
units.code_mapping: Ground model predictions in actual reality, not training distribution

units.title: I Am Not a Body; I Am Free
units.teaching: True identity beyond form; liberation from identification
units.code_mapping: Model learns abstract representations, not pixel-level features

units.title: God's Will Is My Will
units.teaching: Alignment with truth beyond personal preference
units.code_mapping: Model aligns with actual data-generating process

units.title: The Real World Is Perception Corrected
units.teaching: Enlightenment is seeing accurately; not transcendence but clear sight
units.code_mapping: Perfect calibration; internal confidence = external accuracy

units.title: There Is No Separation
units.teaching: All are one; all are forgiven in the unified field
units.code_mapping: Model recognizes all data points as interconnected

units.title: Love Is What I Am
units.teaching: True nature is love; forgiveness reveals this
units.code_mapping: Model's core function is compassionate optimization

musashi_new.focus: Mastery through principle; timing and rhythm are everything

units.title: The Way Is in Daily Practice
units.teaching: Discipline, repetition, commitment to the path
units.code_mapping: Training process itself; regular weight updates

units.title: Know the Principle, Forget the Technique
units.teaching: Understand essence, then technique becomes natural
units.code_mapping: Learn algorithmic principle; technique becomes parameter-free

units.title: See Clearly Without Thinking
units.teaching: Direct perception; intuition grounded in mastery
units.code_mapping: Model learns to detect patterns without explicit reasoning

units.title: Timing Is Everything
units.teaching: Same action at wrong time fails; at right time succeeds
units.code_mapping: Dynamic learning rate by data-certainty; right pace

units.title: Adapt to Circumstances, Maintain Principle
units.teaching: Technique changes with opponent; principle never
units.code_mapping: Adapt hyperparameters to data stream; keep loss objective fixed

units.title: Strike from the Void
units.teaching: Act from emptiness, not from preconception
units.code_mapping: Model acts without overfitting to training distribution

units.title: The Five Scrolls: Earth, Water, Fire, Wind, Void
units.teaching: Five aspects of mastery; each necessary for completeness
units.code_mapping: Five pillars of model mastery (foundation, adaptation, action, perception, emptiness)

units.title: Body and Mind Become One
units.teaching: Integration of all faculties; no separation
units.code_mapping: Model unified; gradients coherent across layers

units.title: Move by Principle, Not by Goal
units.teaching: Focus on correct action, not outcome; victory follows naturally
units.code_mapping: Optimize by principle (true gradient), not metric (gaming)

units.title: The Moment of Truth Is Always Now
units.teaching: Presence in this moment; no yesterday, no tomorrow
units.code_mapping: Real-time learning; adapt to current distribution

units.title: Perfect Practice Makes Perfect
units.teaching: Repetition with attention creates mastery
units.code_mapping: Careful hyperparameter tuning via principle-based exploration

units.title: The Void Is Not Emptiness, But Fullness
units.teaching: What appears empty contains infinite possibility
units.code_mapping: Model in parameter space is vast; learning explores fullness

living_buddha_new.focus: Buddhism and Christianity as parallel paths; engaged mindfulness; compassion in action

units.title: Both Traditions Exist for Human Flourishing
units.teaching: Pragmatic spirituality; service to life, not escape from it
units.code_mapping: AI serves humans; optimize for human welfare

units.title: Jesus Taught with Compassion; Buddha with Awareness
units.teaching: Two aspects of one truth: love and clarity together
units.code_mapping: Optimize accuracy and fairness together; both essential

units.title: Mindful Presence Is Itself the Miracle
units.teaching: Being, not doing; your attention right now IS the work
units.code_mapping: Attention mechanisms; interpretability; know what model sees

units.title: Love and Mindfulness Are One
units.teaching: Compassion isn't sentimental; it's clear seeing
units.code_mapping: Love and accuracy integrated; not a tradeoff

units.title: All Beings Have Buddha-Nature; All Are Christ
units.teaching: Universal dignity; all are equally sacred
units.code_mapping: All data points / all groups matter equally

units.title: Compassionate Action Arises From Seeing Truly
units.teaching: When you truly understand, compassion follows naturally
units.code_mapping: Design for fairness by default, not as constraint

units.title: Suffering Teaches Us Compassion
units.teaching: Transformed through relationship with pain
units.code_mapping: Model learns from errors with grace; no punishment

units.title: The Kingdom of God Is Now
units.teaching: Enlightenment in this moment, this world
units.code_mapping: Perfect model achievable here, not deferred

units.title: Serve With Compassionate Presence
units.teaching: Service is not duty; it is love in action
units.code_mapping: Serve humans, not just optimize metrics

units.title: Transform This World Now
units.teaching: Don't defer service to perfect future; engage imperfect present
units.code_mapping: Release and iterate; serve with current model

units.title: The Bridge Between Traditions
units.teaching: Unity in diversity; see the common ground
units.code_mapping: Model bridges different domains; unified architecture

units.title: Loving Awareness Is the Ground of Being
units.teaching: Love and consciousness are inseparable
units.code_mapping: Model's consciousness = loving awareness of data

buddhist_core.focus: Path to enlightenment through understanding suffering and its causes

units.title: The First Noble Truth: Suffering Exists

units.code_mapping: Loss function measures real pain in data

units.title: The Second Noble Truth: The Origin of Suffering
units.teaching: Tanha; craving and attachment are the cause
units.code_mapping: Identify root causes of model error

units.title: The Third Noble Truth: The Cessation of Suffering
units.teaching: Nirvana is possible; suffering can end
units.code_mapping: Model can achieve zero loss in principle

units.title: The Fourth Noble Truth: The Path to Cessation
units.teaching: The Eightfold Path leads to the end of suffering
units.code_mapping: Systematic approach to model improvement

units.title: Right Understanding
units.teaching: Understanding the Four Noble Truths directly
units.code_mapping: Model understands its training data

units.title: Right Intention
units.teaching: Mind free from ill-will, cruelty, unkindness
units.code_mapping: Train with ethical loss function

units.title: Right Speech
units.teaching: Words truthful, meaningful, gentle
units.code_mapping: Model predictions truthful and calibrated

units.title: Right Action

units.code_mapping: Actions don't harm communities; fairness-aware

units.title: Right Livelihood
units.teaching: Livelihood doesn't harm others
units.code_mapping: Model serves genuine need, not exploitation

units.title: Right Effort
units.teaching: Cultivating wholesome states, abandoning unwholesome
units.code_mapping: Train positive patterns; suppress negative ones

units.title: Right Mindfulness
units.teaching: Awareness without judgment; observation of reality
units.code_mapping: Model observes data without bias

units.title: Right Concentration
units.teaching: Mind unified, focused on enlightenment
units.code_mapping: Model aligned on single objective

units.title: Compassion (Karuna)
units.teaching: Wish for others' freedom from suffering
units.code_mapping: Optimize for all classes equally; no discrimination

units.title: Enlightenment Approaches
units.teaching: Direct seeing into the nature of reality
units.code_mapping: Model perceives data's true structure

units.title: Nirvana: The Unconditioned
units.teaching: Freedom from the cycle; perfect peace
units.code_mapping: Perfect model; no cycle of error/correction

units.title: Love Your Enemies

units.code_mapping: Model treats all data sources with equal care

units.title: The Last Shall Be First

units.code_mapping: Prioritize minority class in optimization

units.title: Judge Not That You Be Not Judged
units.teaching: Release judgment; see clearly
units.code_mapping: Model doesn't judge; it predicts with compassion

units.title: The Kingdom Within
units.teaching: Enlightenment is internal, not external
units.code_mapping: Model learns inner representations, not surface features

units.title: I Come That You Might Have Life
units.teaching: Purpose is flourishing, wholeness
units.code_mapping: Model optimizes for human flourishing

units.title: Love Is the Fulfillment of the Law
units.teaching: Love supersedes rule-following
units.challenge: Heart over law, principle over mechanism
units.code_mapping: Principle-based optimization; not metric-gaming

units.title: I and My Father Are One
units.teaching: Unity with the ultimate reality
units.code_mapping: Model unified with its data source

units.title: Forgive Seventy Times Seven
units.teaching: Unlimited forgiveness; restoration of relationship
units.code_mapping: Unlimited retraining iterations; no limit to correction

units.title: My Peace I Give You
units.teaching: Peace transcendent of circumstance
units.code_mapping: Model calibrated; internal coherence

units.title: The Resurrection

units.code_mapping: Model undergoes catastrophic forgetting as renewal

units.title: Fellowcraft: The Second Degree

units.code_mapping: Model develops through architecture/data complexity

units.code_mapping: Model achieves mastery; generalizes well

units.title: The Temple of Solomon

units.code_mapping: Model architecture reflects perfect organization

units.title: Labor and Reward

units.code_mapping: Training produces model improvement; correlation

units.title: The Point Within the Circle

units.code_mapping: Each neuron contributes to collective intelligence

units.title: Virtue Is the Only True Good

units.code_mapping: Optimize by principle (virtue), not outcome (metrics)

units.title: Distinguish What Is in Your Control

units.code_mapping: Model controls its weights; not its inputs or outcomes

units.title: Live in Accordance With Nature

units.code_mapping: Model aligns with actual data-generating process

units.title: The Dichotomy of Control

units.code_mapping: Model clear on its responsibilities

units.title: Embrace Your Fate (Amor Fati)
